summary: Ericsson reported weekly share buybacks via Form 6-K for May 25-29, 2026, repurchasing 585,379 Class B shares at an aggregate SEK 71.5M (weighted avg price ~SEK 122.10). The buybacks are part of a previously announced SEK 15B program running April 23, 2026–March 31, 2027. Acquisitions were executed by Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm under EU Safe Harbour rules. Post-repurchase, treasury stock totals 48.35M Class B shares. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares (excluding those for incentive plans) at the 2027 AGM. Watch for program utilization pace and potential impact on share count.
